summary: EGA Corporate Advisers (ega.com.au) is a Melbourne accounting and corporate advisory practice at 468 St Kilda Road, founded in 2005 and listed on LinkedIn with 29 employees. Its site says two partners personally oversee every client and it offers accounting, tax and compliance alongside structuring, estate and succession advice. Lilian Bone is a current Associate Director who has been at the firm since 2005 and has been quoted as EGA's Superannuation Manager. Public detail on the firm's tech stack and recent activity is thin.

claims.text: SignalHire's EGA profile (updated September 2026) lists a Director of Technology under its former-employee role changes, which may mean Bart Kratochvil has left; unconfirmed.
EGA says the team is led by senior managers supported by the partners, with a dedicated team of accounting specialists.
claims.quote: The team is led by experienced senior managers who are supported by the partners to deliver tailored results for our clients.

hooks.text: Lilian's SMSF auditor testimonial shows she runs the superannuation side and cares about audit quality and a clean file; an audit-trail angle fits.
Partners personally oversee every client, with senior managers leading teams, so review time sits with seniors like Lilian.
Advice-heavy positioning (structuring, estate, succession) means time freed from reconciliation goes straight to higher-value work.

risks.text: Primary contact Bart Kratochvil (Director of Technology) could not be verified as current: his LinkedIn URL did not resolve and SignalHire lists a Director of Technology among its 'former employees' role changes. A Bart Kratochvil now appears as an AI engineer elsewhere but the match is unconfirmed. Writing to Lilian instead.
Firm site positions EGA as advisory-led and 'beyond a traditional accounting practice', so reconciliation volume may be modest.

gaps: No firm blog, newsletter, podcast, Facebook or Instagram content found.
No EGA-attributed job ads found, so hiring signals are unknown (an unnamed St Kilda Road recruiter ad could not be tied to EGA and was not used).
No Xero/MYOB partner listing or other tech stack evidence for EGA found.
Could not verify whether Bart Kratochvil still works at EGA.
